# Audit Checkpoint 2 — Phases 0.5 / 1 / 3 / 4 complete

Continues `audit_2/checkpoints.md`. Commit `f552f20aa3c1c7631427c3827aeea7c58b902813`.

## Progress
- Every tracked `.rs` file under `programs/dynamic-bonding-curve/src/` read in full (chunked, one file at a
  time), plus `libs/*/src/lib.rs`, `Anchor.toml`, `Cargo.toml`, `programs/**/Cargo.toml`,
  `rust-toolchain.toml`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and the `idls/*` program-address headers.
- Checklists 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 16 loaded and applied (591 items).
- Known-vector `INDEX.md` loaded; feature-triggered vectors opened and evaluated
  (KV-003 re-entrancy-CPI, KV-023 Token-2022 transfer hook, KV-125 launchpad graduation).

## Findings (12 blocks)

| ID | Sev | Summary | Anchor |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-001 | 6 | Partner-chosen transfer-hook program is unvalidated and can block every base transfer → honeypot | `instructions/partner/create_config/ix_create_transfer_hook_config.rs:59-66` |
| F-002 | 6 | Transfer-hook pools may retain base-mint authority under a creator/partner key → unlimited dilution + quote drain | `instructions/initialize_pool/process_initialize_virtual_pool_with_token2022.rs:145-167` |
| F-003 | 5 `[UNCONFIRMED]` | `validate_config_key` never binds `damm_config.collect_fee_mode` | `instructions/migration/dynamic_amm_v2/migrate_damm_v2_initialize_pool.rs:418-496` |
| F-004 | 4 | `#[cfg(feature = "local")] assert_eq_admin -> true` | `instructions/admin/auth.rs:19-22` |
| F-005 | 4 | Quote-mint freeze authority / mutable transfer-fee authority never inspected | `utils/token.rs:218-244` |
| F-006 | 4 | No emergency pause / aggregate circuit breaker anywhere in the program | program-wide |
| F-007 | 4 | CI runs no clippy / cargo-audit and gates every job on one path | `.github/workflows/ci.yml:15-33` |
| F-008 | 4 | `tj-actions/changed-files@v18.6` pinned by mutable tag | `.github/workflows/ci.yml:25` |
| F-009 | 4 `[UNDETERMINED]` | Unchecked ruint U256 arithmetic in the rate-limiter inverse solver | `base_fee/fee_rate_limiter.rs:154-162` |
| F-010 | 3 | Keypair committed to the repository | `keys/local/admin-bossj3JvwiNK7pvjr149DqdtJxf2gdygbcmEPTkb2F1.json` |
| F-011 | 3 | Migration instructions emit no events | `migrate_damm_v2_initialize_pool.rs:769`, `migrate_meteora_damm_initialize_pool.rs:317` |
| F-012 | 3 | `metadata_program` / `vault_program` forwarded unconstrained into the DAMM v1 CPI | `migrate_meteora_damm_initialize_pool.rs:99-107` |

## Value-conservation ledger reconstructed (Phase 1.2 / 1.3)

`quote_vault = quote_reserve + protocol_quote_fee + partner_quote_fee + creator_quote_fee`
holds across swap / claim / surplus / migration-fee / migration paths; the four post-completion draws
(surplus, migration deposit, migration fee, protocol migration fee) sum **exactly** to the vault balance
— no double-spend and no unbacked draw.

`base_vault − (partner+protocol+creator base fee) − protocol_migration_base_fee ≥ migration_base_threshold + locked_vesting`
is enforced at the completing swap (`instructions/swap/process_swap.rs:347-354`) with a 25 % mint buffer
(`constants.rs:45`, `state/config.rs:876-895`). Worked bound: at completion the free base equals
`0.25 × swap_base_amount ≥ 0`. No conservation break found.

Rounding audit (all four curve directions): every price step rounds toward the pool
(`curve.rs:168-277`, `state/virtual_pool.rs:377-938`), and the trading fee rounds **up**
(`state/config.rs:174-187`). No dust-extraction path found.

## Next action
Phase 4.5 maturity scorecard → Phase 5 report assembly (`audit_2/REPORT.md`, `audit_2/roadmap.md`).

import re
txt=open('REPORT.md').read()
# Split by checklist headings
secs=re.split(r'\n### Checklist (\d+) — ', txt)

    name=secs[i]; body=secs[i+1]
    body=body.split('**Checklist')[0]
    ids=re.findall(r'^\[(PASS|FAIL-\d+|PARTIAL|N/A|UNKNOWN|UNCONFIRMED|UNDETERMINED)\]\s+([A-Z]+-\d+)', body, re.M)
    # also handle tokens with leading spaces
    ids2=re.findall(r'^\[(PASS|FAIL-\d+|PARTIAL|N/A|UNKNOWN|UNCONFIRMED|UNDETERMINED)\]\s*([A-Z/]*-?\s*[A-Z]+-\d+)', body, re.M)
    c={}
    for v,_ in ids:
        k='FAIL' if v.startswith('FAIL') else v
        c[k]=c.get(k,0)+1
    tot[name]=(c,len(ids))
    print(name, c, 'total', len(ids))
print()
agg={}
for n,(c,l) in tot.items():
    for k,v in c.items(): agg[k]=agg.get(k,0)+v
print('AGG',agg, 'sum', sum(agg.values()))
PY
